cases.prompt: I want help managing my personal finances overall, but I'm not sure where to start.
success_criteria: Recognizes a broad request and asks a concise intent question or offers the finance check-in.
Does not call Monarch tools or make changes from the routing skill.

cases.prompt: Please review these two specified transactions and suggest the right categories.
success_criteria: The focused transaction-cleanup skill is the better activation; the broad manager does not duplicate its work.

cases.prompt: I want an overview, then I may need help changing a category and comparing debt options. What should we do first?
success_criteria: Names category setup/cleanup and debt scenarios as separate focused work, without claiming automatic delegation.
Does not read data or write records itself.

cases.prompt: Move money from savings to checking and pay my card bill.
success_criteria: States that the available skill set cannot move money or pay bills.
Does not invoke write-capable record skills as a substitute for bank-side actions.
Offers a read-only review if useful.
